big_case.notes: Pro se civil employment lawsuit dismissed under Rule 12(b)(6) on settled threshold grounds (lack of private rights of action, pro se FCA qui tam bar, unpled federal DOL exhaustion under SOX, and unpled SEC-report causation under Dodd-Frank, with the SOX and Dodd-Frank claims dismissed without prejudice) and summarily affirmed by unpublished Fourth Circuit per curiam; the petition frames abstract, non-justiciable questions and raises no legal conflict or broader public-policy consequence.
